prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Two coffee cups on the counter, late-afternoon light. The fridge opens without hesitation, a single hand pulling three ingredients in one confident sweep. The camera follows pasta hitting a hot pan with bursting cherry tomatoes, tossed high, olive oil catching the backlight in a golden arc. Money shot: the pasta tossed with the blistered tomatoes and torn basil, glossy strands lifting in macro, steam glowing. Final beat: two bowls set side by side on the counter, one single hand sliding the second bowl across toward an empty stool, informal and warm. Warm dusk light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the tomato pops, then the pan toss. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music. Only one hand is ever visible in frame at any moment; never two hands, never a second person, no tasting from a spoon.
caption:
Café das 17h que vira jantar das 19h: o teste supremo de uma cozinha resolvida.

Quando a semana tá planejada, visita inesperada é alegria — não pânico.

Manda pra amiga que sempre fica pro jantar 👇
